[h,m]=t.start_time.split(':').map(Number),mins=Math.min(1440,h*60+m+1),end=String(Math.floor(mins/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(mins%60).padStart(2,'0');\n ask('refresh',{from:t.from,to:t.to,date:t.date,departureAfter:t.start_time,departureBefore:end,exactStations:true,limit:20});s.refreshTicket={id:key(t),leg:s.manage,trainNo:t.train_no};\n }\n if(received&&r.ok&&r.op==='refresh'){\n const ref=s.refreshTicket,t=s.tickets[ref.leg],match=clean(r.value.items).find(x=>x.code===t?.code&&x.train_no===ref.trainNo);\n if(!t||key(t)!==ref.id)s.message='行程已改变，忽略旧余票';else if(!match)s.message='未找到原车次，保留票夹，请重新核实';else{s.tickets[ref.leg]={...t,...match,fetchedAt:r.value.fetchedAt};s.message='仅更新原车次余票';}\n }\n const result=s.results[s.leg];s.rows=result?.items||[];paginate(s.rows);s.loaded=result?.query||null;\n s.raw=JSON.stringify(s.tickets[s.manage]||{},null,2);s.copy=s.tickets.filter(Boolean).map(x=>x.date+' '+x.from+' → '+x.to+' '+x.code+' '+x.start_time).join('；');return s;\n}"} actions={{"search":"request-search","refresh":"request-refresh","select":"expose","focus":"expose","choose":"expose","video":"expose"}}> {leg==0?"去程":"返程"} {local.tickets[leg].code} · {local.tickets[leg].date} {local.tickets[leg].seat=="second_seat"?"二等座":"一等座"} · {local.tickets[leg][local.tickets[leg].seat]??"余票未知"} 在“查找车次”中固定一班{leg==0?"去程":"返程"}。 由用户在官方渠道核实，不用发车时间推算起售。 title: 计算显微镜
source:
<card schemaVersion="1" actionMode="snapshot" theme="soft" palette="a">
 <state id="response" type="record" initial={{seq:0}}/><state id="external" type="string" initial=""/>
 
 <title>计算显微镜</title>
 <logic id="baseline" label="计算显微镜交互" grow={true} reactive={true} initial={{"seen":0,"pending":"","message":"","request":{},"page":0,"pages":1,"pageRows":[],"external":"","raw":"{}","sentence":"我 喜欢 杭州","token":0,"step":0,"delta":0,"residual":true,"neuron":0,"tab":"数值流","all":[],"tokens":[{"value":0,"label":"我"},{"value":1,"label":"喜欢"},{"value":2,"label":"杭州"}],"axes":[],"hidden":[],"activation":[],"attention":[],"vector":[],"contributions":[],"bias":0,"z":0,"activated":0,"output":"","note":"","cur":null}} input={{response:state.response,today:context.localDate,statuses:{}}} source={"function update(state,event,input){
 const s=state,e=event,r=input.response||{};
 if(e.type==="init"&&s.pending){s.pending="";s.message="上次请求已中断，可手动重试";}
 if(e.type==="input"&&s.pending&&input.statuses?.[s.pending]==="cancelled"){s.pending="";s.message="请求已取消，已有内容仍保留";}
 const text=v=>v==null?"":String(v).replace(/<[^>]*>/g,"");
 const key=x=>String(x.rowKey||x.id||x.url||x.title||x.name);
 const clean=rows=>(rows||[]).slice(0,30).map((x,i)=>{
  const v={};for(const [k,t]of Object.entries(x).slice(0,40)){if(t===null||["string","number","boolean"].includes(typeof t))v[k]=typeof t==="string"?text(t).slice(0,900):t;else if(Array.isArray(t)&&t.every(v=>typeof v==="string"))v[k]=t.slice(0,12).map(text).join("、");}
  v.rowKey=key(x)||String(i);v.title=text(x.title||x.name||x.code||x.content||x.text||"未命名").slice(0,120);return v;
 });
 const ask=(op,params)=>{s.request=params;s.pending=op;s.message="正在获取…";};
 const received=!!r.seq&&r.seq!==s.seen;
 if(received){s.seen=r.seq;s.pending="";if(!r.ok)s.message="请求失败，保留已有资料："+text(r.error);}
 if(e.type==="field"){s[e.args.name]=e.value;s.page=0;}
 if(e.type==="tab"){s.tab=e.value;s.page=0;}
 if(e.type==="prev")s.page=Math.max(0,s.page-1);
 if(e.type==="next")s.page++;
 if(e.type==="fault")throw Error("隔离测试：保留上次有效状态");
 const paginate=rows=>{s.page=Math.min(s.page,Math.max(0,Math.ceil(rows.length/3)-1));s.pageRows=rows.slice(s.page*3,s.page*3+3);s.pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(rows.length/3));};

 if(e.type==='token')s.token=Number(e.value);
 if(e.type==='step')s.step=Number(e.value);
 if(e.type==='residual')s.residual=!s.residual;
 if(e.type==='neuron'){s.neuron=Number(e.columnId);s.token=Number(e.rowId);}
 if(e.type==='reset'){s.delta=0;s.residual=true;s.step=0;s.token=0;s.neuron=0;}
 const weights=(n,m,seed)=>Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>Array.from({length:m},(_,j)=>Math.sin((i+1)*13+(j+1)*7+seed)*.6));
 const dot=(a,b)=>a.reduce((v,x,i)=>v+x*b[i],0),mat=(w,x)=>w.map(row=>dot(row,x)),add=(a,b)=>a.map((x,i)=>x+b[i]);
 const norm=x=>{const m=x.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/x.length,v=x.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b-m)**2,0)/x.length;return x.map(t=>(t-m)/Math.sqrt(v+1e-5));};
 const gelu=x=>.5*x*(1+Math.tanh(Math.sqrt(2/Math.PI)*(x+.044715*x**3)));
 const softmax=x=>{const a=x.map(t=>Math.exp(t-Math.max(...x))),n=a.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);return a.map(t=>t/n);};
 const tokens=s.sentence.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,6);if(!tokens.length)tokens.push('词');
 const values=tokens.map((t,i)=>Array.from({length:4},(_,j)=>Math.sin([...t].reduce((a,c)=>a+c.codePointAt(0),0)*.01+j*1.7+i*.3)+(j===0?s.delta:0)));
 const ns=values.map(norm),q=ns.map(x=>mat(weights(4,4,1),x)),k=ns.map(x=>mat(weights(4,4,2),x)),v=ns.map(x=>mat(weights(4,4,3),x)),w1=weights(6,4,5),w2=weights(4,6,9),b1=[.1,-.1,.05,0,.08,-.03],b2=[.02,0,-.02,.01];
 s.all=tokens.map((token,i)=>{const attention=softmax(k.map(ki=>dot(q[i],ki)/2)),mixed=Array.from({length:4},(_,j)=>v.reduce((a,x,n)=>a+attention[n]*x[j],0)),a=mat(weights(4,4,4),mixed),h=s.residual?add(values[i],a):a,n=norm(h),z=add(mat(w1,n),b1),activation=z.map(gelu),f=add(mat(w2,activation),b2),y=s.residual?add(h,f):f;return {token,input:values[i],attention,a,h,n,z,activation,f,y};});
 s.token=Math.min(s.token,tokens.length-1);s.cur=s.all[s.token];s.tokens=tokens.map((label,i)=>({value:i,label}));s.axes=tokens.map((label,i)=>({id:String(i),label}));
 s.hidden=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>({id:String(i),label:'h'+(i+1)}));s.activation=s.all.map(x=>x.activation);s.attention=s.all.map(x=>x.attention);
 const notes=['教学嵌入：token → 四维向量','Attention(LN(x))：按注意力汇聚 token','h = x + Attention(LN(x))','GELU(W₁ × LN(h) + b₁)','f = W₂ × activation + b₂','y = h + f → 下一层'];
 s.note=notes[s.step]+(!s.residual&&[2,5].includes(s.step)?'（当前残差已关闭）':'');
 s.vector=[s.cur.input,s.cur.a,s.cur.h,s.cur.activation,s.cur.f,s.cur.y][s.step].map((value,i)=>({id:String(i),label:'d'+(i+1),value}));
 s.contributions=s.cur.n.map((n,i)=>({id:String(i),label:'n'+(i+1)+'×W₁',value:n*w1[s.neuron][i]}));
 s.bias=b1[s.neuron];s.z=s.cur.z[s.neuron];s.activated=s.cur.activation[s.neuron];s.output=s.cur.y.map(x=>Math.round(x*1000)/1000).join(' · ');
 return s;
}"} actions={{"select":"expose","focus":"expose","choose":"expose","video":"expose"}}>
 
<segmented label="当前视图" value={local.tab} options={["数值流","注意力","FFN显微镜","输入设置"]} onChange="tab"/>
<region role="content" overflow="scroll" label="一层 Transformer" resetKey={local.tab}>
<segmented label="观察 token" value={local.token} options={local.tokens} onChange="token"/>
<if test={local.tab=="数值流"}>
 <segmented label="计算步骤" value={local.step} options={[{value:0,label:"输入"},{value:1,label:"注意力"},{value:2,label:"残差①"},{value:3,label:"激活"},{value:4,label:"投影"},{value:5,label:"输出"}]} onChange="step"/>
 <caption>{local.note}</caption><chart label="当前阶段向量（含正负值）" data={local.vector}/><caption>最终输出：{local.output}</caption>
</if>
<if test={local.tab=="注意力"}><heatmap label="谁在关注谁 · 每行权重和为 1" rows={local.axes} columns={local.axes} values={local.attention}/><caption>每个 token 的 Q 对所有 K 打分，经 softmax 后汇聚 V。</caption></if>
<if test={local.tab=="FFN显微镜"}>
 <heatmap label="token × 隐藏神经元 · 点击一个激活" rows={local.axes} columns={local.hidden} values={local.activation} selectedRow={string(local.token)} selectedColumn={string(local.neuron)} onSelect="neuron"/>
 <caption>共享 W₁，token 以输入贡献激活 h{local.neuron+1}；权重本身不改变。</caption>
 <chart label="四维输入对当前神经元的贡献" data={local.contributions}/>
 <caption>贡献和 + 偏置 {formatNumber(local.bias,3)} = {formatNumber(local.z,3)} → GELU {formatNumber(local.activated,3)}</caption>
</if>
<if test={local.tab=="输入设置"}>
 <input label="句子（空格分 token，最多六个）" inputType="text" value={local.sentence} onChange="field" args={{name:"sentence"}}/>
 <slider label="输入第一维扰动" min={-2} max={2} step={0.25} value={local.delta} onChange="field" args={{name:"delta"}}/>
 <toggle label="启用两条残差连接" checked={local.residual} onChange="residual"/><button onPress="reset" >重置实验</button>
 <caption>固定教学权重：4 → 6 → 4；Pre-LN。不是已训练模型，不输出真实语言预测。</caption>
</if>
</region>
 </logic>
 <action id="expose"><set target="external" value={event.result.external}/></action>
 <if test={state.external!=""||false}><row wrap space="tight"><if test={state.external!=""}><link url={state.external}>打开所选来源 ↗</link></if>
 
 
 </row></if>
 </card>
